card.name: Linking words in dopamine drug warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, for, of, between and other, placed just before a drug, condition or interacting-medication term in dopamine-agonist labels (cabergoline, lanreotide, dopamine antagonists).

modes.label: Preposition before condition
modes.description: With or for after a patient group or use, before the condition or use is named.
modes.example: In a 4-week, placebo-controlled trial in patients<< with>> hyperprolactinemic disorders,

modes.label: Interaction linking words
modes.description: Between, other or co- before the drugs that interact.
